curse-down.rule: Four action-cost CURSE ritual poses directed down-right: neutral; BOTH empty hands rise apart with open palms framing chest/head; BOTH arms perform broad decisive downward binding/commanding gesture toward down-right; both hands withdraw/recover to neutral. Knife stays sheathed. Distinct broad two-handed silhouette from normal single FAR LEFT hand shot. No projectile, attack, glowing staff, beam or giant magic circle. Only tiny restrained dark-crimson fingertip glint at gesture. Third painted pose is spell climax, native index4 after holds. This is one finite paid-action Curse, not a free attack.

death.rule: Monotonic collapse: standing; both knees buckle into a low kneel; torso falls sideways toward ground with knees collapsed; final completely prone motionless corpse on its side. Head height decreases through every pose. No recovery, floating, ghost, gore, standing corpse or leaving frame.

defend.rule: Three genuinely different poses: neutral; knees flex and NEAR right forearm with short ritual knife braces diagonally across chest, FAR empty left palm warding outward; recover to neutral. Actual blocking, not attack or spell.

fidget.rule: One subtle equipment check: neutral planted stance; free hand reaches vial belt; fingertips inspect one attached vial; hand returns to neutral. Boots, head and hip stay at the same position; no swaying or whole-body wobble.

hit.rule: Hit recoil: neutral; chest recoils backward while knees flex; body briefly hunches forward after the impact; recovery to neutral. Feet remain planted. Not a knife attack or idle sequence.

melee-down.rule: Four knife melee poses aimed down-right: neutral with knife in NEAR right hand by near hip; draw same knife hand backward/wind up while free FAR left hand balances; decisive short-knife thrust down-right with torso lean; recover same near knife hand to hip. Exact same hand holds same short blade in ALL poses, never swap hands. Impact is third painted pose, native frame index4 after explicit holds. No spell, wand, staff, projectile or gore.

shot-down.rule: Four ranged hemomancy poses aimed down-right: neutral; FAR LEFT empty palm cups a tiny dull crimson focus near chest while NEAR RIGHT hand stays by knife at hip; FAR LEFT empty hand extends down-right decisively and releases focus; return FAR LEFT hand toward waist/neutral. Knife remains sheathed at near hip throughout; NO knife in casting hand, NO staff. This is ordinary ranged channel/release, NOT the broad two-handed Curse ritual. Third painted pose releases, native index4 after holds. Small dim crimson pinlight close to empty left palm only in charge/release; NO traveling projectile, beam, detached orb, cloud or extra scenery.

turn-in.rule: Native TURN-IN ONLY: start facing screen RIGHT at usual three-quarter angle; rotate toward viewer through right-front angle; end front-facing midpoint with chest toward viewer. Do NOT return to right, do NOT show back. Same body/feet pivot.

turn-out.rule: Native TURN-OUT ONLY: start front-facing midpoint with chest toward viewer; rotate through right-front angle; end facing screen RIGHT at usual three-quarter angle. Do NOT turn to back or left. Engine mirrors after direction toggle; this source stays right-facing at end.

walk.rule: Four-phase complete walking cycle: left-foot contact/right foot back; left leg supports while right passes; right-foot contact/left foot back; right leg supports while left passes. Alternate actual leg contacts. Separate boots visible below the split robe; no floating, root translation or skating.
